home.title: Backend Engineer
home.subtitle: ASP.NET Core · Azure · REST APIs
home.description: I build REST APIs and payment systems with ASP.NET Core and Azure. 4+ years of backend experience, two of them leading the backend of production mobile apps with 3,000+ monthly active users.

apis.title: APIs & Contracts
apis.description: Full-cycle REST API design: requirements analysis, use case definition, OpenAPI/Swagger documentation, and production support. I prioritize contract clarity, versioning, and compatibility with mobile clients.

cloud.title: Cloud & Architecture
cloud.description: Cloud-native architecture with Azure Functions and ASP.NET Core. I design systems with event-driven async processing using Azure Storage Queues and Worker Services. I evaluate deployment models, serverless vs App Service, analyzing operational cost, scalability, and latency based on each product's requirements.

security.title: Security
security.description: Security applied from the first commit, not as an afterthought. I implement stateless JWT authentication, endpoint-level RBAC, OAuth 2.0 with Google and Apple, and Redis-backed rate limiting against brute-force and credential-stuffing attacks. Background in SecDevOps in enterprise environments at Ernst & Young.

payments.title: Payments & Integrations
payments.description: Full Stripe integration: webhooks, idempotency, and subscription lifecycle management. Native subscriptions with Apple App Store and Google Play including server-side receipt validation. Handling of renewals, grace periods, refunds, and revocations, reconciled against each store's state.

home.metaDescription: Backend Engineer in Málaga, Spain. 4+ years with ASP.NET Core, Azure and PostgreSQL: REST APIs, JWT and OAuth 2.0 auth, Stripe and in-app payments.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Professional backend engineering work, open source, and personal projects.

prodigy.name: Prodigy Padel Academy
prodigy.description: Sports training platform for padel players, built around a proven 25-year methodology. Backend: gamification system (points, levels, achievements, leaderboards), Stripe payments, App Store and Google Play in-app purchases, optimized PostgreSQL architecture, Redis rate limiting, and JWT authentication with RBAC and OAuth 2.0.

koru.name: Koru Acne
koru.description: Mobile app for skin tracking and an acne support community. Backend: REST API design, JWT and OAuth 2.0 authentication (Google and Apple), and a PostgreSQL data model for users, photo-based skin logs, trigger factors, and wellness content.

dailydermatalks.name: DailyDermaTalks
dailydermatalks.description: Web learning platform for a community of dermatologists, with restricted access and controlled capacity: access is granted manually by an administrator. Full design and implementation: REST APIs, JWT authentication with RBAC, CMS for content management, Upstash Redis rate limiting, and PostgreSQL database architecture. Deployed on Vercel.

storebridge.name: StoreBridge
storebridge.description: Open-source .NET library, published on NuGet, for server-side verification of Apple App Store and Google Play subscriptions and in-app purchases. It unifies both stores' APIs and webhooks behind a single interface, cryptographically authenticates notifications (Apple x5c chain anchored to Apple Root CA G3 and Google Pub/Sub OIDC tokens), retries on transient failures, and validates configuration at startup. Targets .NET 8, 9, and 10, with 197 unit tests.

galivivienda.name: Galivivienda VPO Calculator
galivivienda.description: Interactive calculator to analyze the real cost of a cooperative VPO housing unit in Vélez-Málaga, based on the public documentation for the Galivivienda Fortalezas de Vélez development (188 units, EMVIPSA). Built because the official information is fragmented across multiple contracts with unclear terms. It lets users simulate different IPC scenarios, rental years, and discount percentages to calculate the actual total cost before signing. Implementation: real-time financial calculations with monthly compound interest, a rent evolution chart rendered with pure JS (no canvas or libraries), responsive design with adaptive grid and native mobile bottom-sheet, and full SEO with JSON-LD. Immediate organic traction when shared in local Facebook groups.

about.title: About
about.description: Backend Engineer with 4+ years of experience designing and building scalable cloud-native systems using ASP.NET Core, Azure Functions, and Java. Specialized in REST API design, authentication systems (JWT, OAuth 2.0, RBAC), payment integrations (Stripe, App Store, Google Play), and PostgreSQL database architecture. Experience leading backend development across products serving thousands of monthly active users.

intro.paragraph1: At The Bubble Hub I owned the full backend engineering lifecycle for two production mobile products: requirements analysis, API contract design, data architecture, implementation, third-party integrations, and production support. I made technical decisions on architecture, data modeling, and security.
intro.paragraph2: The backend I designed covers layered security, event-driven async processing, and complex payment integrations with Stripe, App Store, and Google Play. Every architectural decision had direct impact on performance and user experience.
intro.paragraph3: Before this, at Ernst & Young I worked in enterprise environments with regulated software lifecycles and strict security requirements. That context, marked by SecDevOps, audits, and systems processing millions of daily events, shapes how I approach any design today: security applied from the first commit, not as an afterthought.
intro.paragraph4: I'm currently completing a Master's in Artificial Intelligence at UNIR, which included a curricular internship at Kaizten Analytics applying AI to software development. I'm particularly interested in designing maintainable backend architectures, distributed systems, and cloud solutions capable of evolving over the long term.

kaizten.description: Curricular internship within the Master's in Artificial Intelligence at UNIR, as sole developer of the tooling that connects Kaizten's code standards analyzer to AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity) through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), in Java 17. Shipped it as one cross-platform distribution: one-line installers for Linux, macOS, and Windows, a Maven plugin, and a CI quality gate, with 17 releases automated through GitHub Actions and Docker, 1,500+ automated tests, and bilingual user documentation generated with each release.

junta.description: Taught Computer Science as a temporary teacher at a public school run by the Andalusian regional government.

bubbleHub.description: Led backend development for Prodigy Padel Academy and Koru: two mobile products serving 3,000+ monthly active users. Full ownership of the engineering lifecycle: requirements analysis, OpenAPI/Swagger contract design, implementation with ASP.NET Core and Azure Functions, payment integrations (Stripe, Apple IAP, Google Play), and production support. Optimized PostgreSQL architecture, JWT/RBAC/OAuth 2.0 authentication, Redis rate limiting, async processing with Azure Storage Queues, and CI/CD pipelines with SonarCloud in Azure DevOps.

ey.description: Backend development and SecDevOps in enterprise environments with regulated software lifecycles. ASP.NET components with security applied by design: input validation, data encryption, least-privilege access control. CI/CD pipeline optimization with Jenkins and GitHub Actions. Integration of 10+ security sources into SIEM platforms (IBM QRadar, Splunk, Wazuh).
